verdict.rationale: The evidence describes recording with a visible bot or without one, and organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained. Neither documents a consent capability: there are no participant notifications, no in-meeting disclosure messages, and no admin setting that enforces transparency (for example, requiring the visible bot). The bot-less desktop capture option, if anything, cuts against enforced disclosure, so the cited items are adjacent controls rather than consent features.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the product ships real consent features — participant notifications, in-meeting disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency — not just a policy PDF
